system.description:
Usage worn or carried; Weight 1 lb.

These palm-sized stones are engraved on one side with a road and on the other with a doorway. A Waystone grows faintly warmer when its bearer travels towards a place where they were once genuinely welcomed.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Survival checks made to navigate, avoid becoming lost or follow recognised pilgrimage routes. When you first invest the stone, designate one settlement, shrine, sanctuary or other fixed place you have personally visited. While on the same plane, you always know its general direction.

You also gain the Walk the Road ability:

Walk the Road:

Activate Command (1 AP)

Frequency 1/day

You gain the effects of Long Stride. The Waystone does not reveal a safe route or distance to the designated location.

On the sheet: +2 status is offered on Survival to navigate; Walk the Road is Long Stride as an innate spell, 1/day. The designated place and its direction are the table's.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Pilgrim's Waystone
conditionals.scope: Survival checks to navigate, avoid becoming lost or follow a recognised pilgrimage route
